SPECIFICATION FOR WROUGHT ALUMINIUM UTENSILS
PART VII BOX, LUNCH

The lid shall be of p u s h - o n

5.2 The lunch box shall have no sharp edges its construction shall be such that it is possible to clean it thoroughly and all surfaces for cleaning are accessible to hand or brush. It shall be free from distortion, dents, wrinkles, scratches, pits, deep toolmarks and other surface defects. 5.3 The lunch box, if anodized, the anodic coating shall be according to Grade ACS of IS : 1 8 6 8 - 1 9 6 8 'Specification for anodic coatings on aluminium ( first revision )'. The method of testing of anodic coatings shall be as given in 6.2 to 6.7 . 6. T e a t s 6.1 Performance Test -- Complete lunch box shall be tested for effective securing of the lid by snapping the clip on and off 2 0 0 0 times. After the test, no weakening or d a m a g e to the securing arrangement shall be observed. 6.2 Thickness of Coating -- Shall be tested according to 2 of IS : 5 5 2 3 - 1 9 6 9 Methods of testing anodic coatings on aluminium'. 5.3 Resistance to Abrasion -- Rub the surface 2 to 3 times with emery paper [ Grit 180 of IS : 7 1 5 1968 'Specification for coated abrasives, glue bound ( s e c o n d revision ) ' ] using a medium finger pressure. This should result in a slight trace of whitening of surface. The paper shall just skid over and not abrade it. 6 . 4 Sealing -- Shall be tested as specified in 5.2 of IS : 6 5 2 3 - 1 9 6 9 .

6.5 Salt Spray -- The coating shall withstand spraying for 15 hours of solution containing 5 percent sodium chloride, and 1 percent glacial acetic acid with p H 3.2 to 3.4 . Gr 1

All dimensions in millimetres FIG. 1 BOX, LUNCH, ALUMINIUM 6.6 Continuity of Coating -- Cut a test piece ( 10 � 5 cm size ) from the anodized lunch box and immerse in the following solution: Copper sulphate solution Hydrochloric acid ( 22� B'e ) Water No black spot shall appear after 5 minutes. 6.7 Ground Nut Oil Test for Leakage -- The inner pot shall be filled half with ground nut oil at room temperature. The box shall then be inverted after the gasket is fixed in position over the inner pot, the lid put on and clips snapped on. No appreciable leakage of the oil from the inner pot shall occur after one minute. 7. Marking -- The lunch box shall be suitably marked with the manufacturers name, registered trade mark or identification mark; and the country of manufacture The impression of the marking shall not show up on the inside. 7.1 Certification Marking -- Details available from the Bureau of Indian Standards. 8. Packing -- The lunch box shall be wrapped in soft tissue paper and packed in accordance with the trade practice. 20 g 20 ml 1 litre
